newsitem.title: USA: China buys South American soyoil - U.S. traders.
newsitem.headline: China buys South American soyoil - U.S. traders.

text.p: U.S. vegetable oil dealers said China this week bought between 20,000 and 30,000 tonnes of South American soybean oil for January and February shipment.
One dealer said on Wednesday that China bought 10,000 tonnes of Argentina soybean oil at $513.00 per tonne, FOB, and on Tuesday bought 10,000 of Brazilian soybean oil at $507.00.
Other soybean oil dealers said the Argentina sale may have been 20,000 tonnes, but they could not confirm that amount.
Other vegetable oil exporters said they could not confirm the China purchase but said Chinese buyers have been making inquiries this week aimed at buying both South American and U.S. soybean oil.
Also, USDA's weekly export report released early Thursday reported China bought 32,000 tonnes of U.S. soybean oil during the week ended January 2.

Exporters and soyoil dealers said U.S. soyoil was about $10 per tonne more expensive than South American product. Some industry sources quoted U.S. FOB soybean oil at $520.50 per tonne for January and February shipment.
